Deploy Bot: Canary rollout (canary-2026-04-12) at 40% -> alert: p95 latency +125% vs baseline, error rate 0.9% (threshold 0.5%). Auto-rollback: DISABLED (manual-gate). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/r/abc123 :warning:
Maya: @here saw this, thanks. Do we want auto-revert or manual?
Samir: Auto-rollback is off for this release — release flagged manual-gate for DB migration concern. I'm oncall and digging into traces. :eyes:
Lee: From what I see the error spike is HTTP 502s from model runtime, not infra. My vote: cut canary and pin previous stable model. Manual revert to stable v3.2.1.
Deploy Bot: Available operation: `/deploy adjust-traffic --from canary-2026-04-12 --to stable --percent 100`
Maya: Agreed. Quick decision checklist: Criteria for rollback we use = p95 > 1.5x baseline for 3 consecutive 60s windows OR error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. We hit the error-rate condition (0.9% for the last 6m).
Zara: I'll own the rollback and outbound comms. @Jess can you prepare a short customer note for dedicated customers? :white_check_mark:
Jess: Drafting now. Suggest: "We are reverting today's canary deployment to maintain service stability. No customer data was affected. We expect to reattempt after investigation (ETA ~1h)." Want me to post in #customers and email CSMs?
Maya: Yes, post and ping CSMs. Also update release notes with revert reason.
Samir: Executing traffic cut now — running internal script: 
```
$ ./scripts/cut_canary.sh --from canary-2026-04-12 --to stable --confirm
Cutting canary -> 0%...
OK 100% traffic to stable v3.2.1
```
Oncall Bot: Action detected: manual-rollback executed by Samir. Created ticket INF-7391 (ops).
Samir: Metrics rolling in — p95 dropping, error rate at 0.12%. Looks like revert worked.
Maya: Great. Next steps: 1) short RCA draft in INF-7391, 2) add a gating note to release checklist so future canaries with manual-gate have an explicit auto-rollback override, 3) schedule a postmortem if we see recurrence.
Lee: I'll add the gating change to the runbook and send a PR for the deploy config (toggle: allow-auto-rollback-for-canaries = true/false).
Zara: Comms posted to #customers and informed affected accounts. Also updated the release entry with rollback note and link to INF-7391. :loudspeaker:
Jess: Sent email to CSMs and copy of the customer note.
Maya: Closing thread once INF-7391 has the RCA. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
